title: Restoration of the source configuration
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a type, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine on input $x$. For any one-step action $a$, history list $h$, and input-head position $p$, one step of the restoration machine from the mid-restoration configuration determined by $c,a,h,p$ is exactly the restoration checkpoint configuration determined by $c,h,p$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of source work tapes
A source configuration on a Boolean input
replaced:
Let $c$ be a source configuration, $a$ an action, $h$ a history list, and $p$ an
input-head position. One step of the restoration machine from the mid-restoration
configuration for $c$, $a$, $h$ and $p$ equals the checkpoint configuration for $c$
and $h$ at $p$: the retained old symbols are written back, restoring the source
tapes to their contents in $c$, and the history heads move back onto the last
entry of $h$.
